View.Label: Style Ti Elements, IDs, and classes in `config.cjs` using native Titanium properties directly — no `apply` needed.
Naming Conventions
Ti Elements: exact name (`Label`, `Button`). IDs: camelCase (`#mainBanner`). Classes: kebab-case (`.my-class`).
Block Types

Label.class: mx-4 mb-4 mt-1 h-auto text-xs text-slate-500

View.Label: `DEFAULT` (global), `ios`, `android`, `tablet`, `handheld`, `[if=Alloy.Globals.X]` (conditional).
Style Elements Globally
Set default properties for any Titanium element:

TextArea.class: h-auto w-screen rounded-lg bg-slate-900 p-2 font-mono text-xs text-cyan-400

Label.class: fas fa-copy mt-0 mr-0 wh-8 text-center text-sm text-slate-600
mx-4 mb-4 mt-2 h-auto text-xs text-slate-400
